description: A two-panel file manager with your shell built in. Files, Git, Docker, and remote sessions in one terminal.
tagline: A two-panel file manager with your shell built in.
intro: Browse files, preview code, inspect Git changes, and open container or remote sessions without leaving your terminal. Borg runs on macOS and Linux, with Bash, zsh, and fish.
filesAlt: Borg file panels in the Classic blue theme, with a file preview and embedded command line.
dockerAlt: Container list, live resource statistics, and a container file panel in Borg.
activityAlt: Borg activity monitor showing sample processes and their memory use.
installCardText: Install Borg, learn the keys, and use the embedded console. F10 quits; Ctrl-O switches between panels and the shell.
filesCardText: Preview and copy files, search recursively, save collections, and measure folder sizes.
connectCardText: Browse Docker containers, open remote Borg sessions, and connect Claude or another agent through MCP.
customizeCardText: Choose a theme and icon style, adjust settings, or build and contribute.
themesText: Six built-in themes, from familiar blue panels to a quiet paper palette. Switch themes in F9 → Options → Theme.
themeAlt: Borg file panels in the {theme} theme.
englishScreenshots: Screenshots use the English interface and fictional sample data.
